column1: # Checked consolidation of FieldType, Datum, conversion-context, truncate, and OutputFormat owners.

column9: note
Parser FieldType moves into the collision-free datatype ownership bundle; its real OutputFormat call path remains independent.
Runtime FieldType aggregation moves into the same ownership bundle without inventing a new consumer.
Typed warning-appender input remains datatype-owned while storage stays external.
Datum scalar and sentinel ordering move into the ownership bundle while remaining on the independent Datum path.
Truncation decision moves with ConversionContext flags and warning input.
OutputFormat moves with FieldType formatting.
Parser FieldType vectors move to the canonical FieldType test target.
Charset partition vectors move with FieldType.
Enum and set length vectors move with FieldType.
FieldType equality vectors move to the canonical owner.
Compact formatting moves with OutputFormat consumption.
Runtime FieldType metadata vectors move to the canonical FieldType test target.
Value-shape FieldType vectors move to the canonical owner.
Aggregate FieldType table vectors move together.
Type-flag aggregate vectors move together.
Integral-promotion vectors move together.
Aggregate eval-type vectors move together.
Context test-file obligation moves with ConversionContext.
WithFlags vectors move with ConversionContext.
Flag vectors move with ConversionContext.
Binary-literal truncation vectors move with their decision context.
Datum sentinel ordering vectors move with the canonical Datum test target.
Formatter file obligation moves with OutputFormat.
Formatter vectors move with OutputFormat.
